page.notes: Scan is a faded 17th-century Latin page with some Gothic-style letterforms and damaged ink; several words (e.g. "præ", "sed", "fuerit", "Pergami", "Theatyræ", "quæst") are read with uncertainty and may be misprinted. Reference marks at the left edge are not transcribed as notes. Words marked as doubtful are not individually flagged in the text due to scan quality: "impunum", "sta-" and "vindices" should be checked against the original. The page's catchword "tuta" is taken as printed at the right foot. Final line of the page is a hyphenated fragment "sta-" with continuation on next page.
